assertions: Real FastAPI TestClient workspace reads return server-derived create capabilities for CON, OWN, SUP, and ADM assignments.

The authority policy lists owner_representative for contract.notice.identify, but its contractor organization scope condition makes the demo OWN assignment unauthorized; the test records the effective engine result rather than assuming the role-code list alone grants access.
An OWN actor's structurally valid direct EOT create request returns HTTP 403 NOT_AUTHORIZED.
Revoking the current SUP qualification is reflected on the next workspace HTTP read for qualification-gated Issue creation, while qualification-independent Contract Notice creation remains available.
Existing fail-closed unconfigured-scope, unavailable-queue, and payment authorization assertions remain intact.

limits: This uses the synthetic demo project and trusted fixture mutation for qualification revocation; it is development acceptance evidence, not a live-project or pilot result.
No UI/browser behavior is asserted by this HTTP test.
No authority matrix, business schema, gate, frontend, CI, dependency, or macOS configuration was changed.
No production session mutation endpoint is exercised; actor changes are represented by separate current-role demo sessions and their real workspace reads.
